name: @avatark/notifications
description: Shared notification contract -- typed events, channels, and a placeholder adapter interface. Contract only: no engine, no delivery mechanism, no database exists yet anywhere in the ecosystem for this.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
